profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My Objective: 
Obtain fulfilling career in software development working to develop new systems for the security of our nation or the advancement of science and infrastructure.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
- Invented, designed, and implementing spaceship simulation game from the ground up.
- Founded company with business partner during free time.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Unity · Architecture · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected, implemented, and integrated remote camera monitoring system for ground station antennas using multithreading in Java.
- Proposed, designed, and implemented new features to existing ground station infrastructure.
- Assumed responsibilities for full system verification for delivery to customer.
- Developed software for cutting edge Battle Management systems in Java, Javascript, and SQL.
- Coordinated development of products with four internal teams and four other companies.
- Created test procedures, documentation, and team education packages.
- Worked development tasks to add functionality to front-end and back-end systems.
- Acted as Subject Matter Expert for system components.
- Created automated integration and unit testing scripts in JUnit and Gradle.
- Setup and utilized containerized deployments in Kubernetes and Docker.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Design · Java · Kubernetes · Software Architecure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Contract
positions.description:
- Developed internal displays for B2 Spirit aircraft within Microsoft Flight Simulator using C/C++.
- Rearchitected data management system.
- Designed modular system for rapid aircraft creation and deployment increasing production rate by over 400%.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
- Invented, architected, developed, and integrated full feature rich remote control tank laser tag system.
- Worked with a network of small system Arduino's to develop massively scalable wireless network.
- Founded company during free time.
- Interviewed, hired, and managed team of seven temporary employees.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Primary developer, maintainer, and integrator of on-site software tools for operators.
- Sole software architect, developer, and integrator for multiple large scale, high visibility initiatives that received Director level recognition.
- Deputy software lead for several years for team of 10 individuals.
- Invented and implemented innovative and modular data distribution system.
- Invented and developed universal software build tool now used internationally, saving 80% of process man hours per operation.
- Performed test, integration, and maintenance of external products into current operating baselines.
- Emergency responder for 24/7 operations support.
- Coordinated test and validation of systems with multiple external groups and customers.
- Acted as primary product installation coordinator for site software.
- Worked collaboratively with government and external companies on multi-company / multi-country contract.
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Software Design · Perl · Software Integration · Software Architecure

positions.title: IT Programming Intern
positions.description:
- Performed feature creation, debug, maintenance of new product information management system. 
- Worked with business users and managers to create technical performance requirements. 
- Created report verification tool for databases through Java.

positions.title: Sheeter Operator
positions.description:
- Helped install new manufacturing equipment, maintained equipment, and developed processes to optimize machine operation as well as normal operation of a sticker sheeter.
- Wrote a User Guide for Vectra Systems RTS 330/410 Sheeter, the manufacturer will include a copy of the guide with each new machine they sell.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Received Eagle Scout at age 14. Continued to work with the Boy Scout Troop until age 18 to help other boys achieve the rank of Eagle Scout.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America

volunteerExperiences.description: Served on the CU Honor Code Panel as a panelist. We heard cases of potential student misconduct or unethical behavior, decided verdicts, and assigned sanctions if necessary.
